question: The total number of sports in the 36th edition of the National Games 2022 of India were _________
solution:
The correct answer is __**36**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **36th edition of the National Games 2022:-**

 
 
• **It was held in Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, and Bhavnagar in the state of Gujarat from September 29 to October 12, 2022. **
 
• It was the first time that Gujarat hosted the National Games.
 
• **A total of 36 sports were included in the program, including athletics, badminton, boxing, cycling, fencing, football, gymnastics, handball, hockey, judo, kabaddi, kho-kho, lawn tennis, mallakhamb, rowing, shooting, swimming, table tennis, taekwondo, volleyball, weightlifting, wrestling, and yogasana.**
 
• The mascot for the Games was the Savaj Asiatic Lion, which is the state animal of Gujarat.
 
• The theme song for the Games was "Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat", which means "One India, Best India".
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Games of India:-**

 
 
• It is a** multi-sport event held every two years**, in which athletes from the different states and union territories of India compete against each other in a variety of sports.
 
• The Games are **organized by the Indian Olympic Association (IOA)** and the government of the host state. 
 
• The National Games were first held in **1924**, and have been held every four years since then, with the exception of 1939 and 1943 due to World War II.
